en: [language] target=carrot; paw interface ready.
zh: [language] target=萝卜；前爪接口就绪。

en: [vision] Candidates: tissue left; carrot right. One manipulator online.
zh: [vision] 左侧纸巾，右侧萝卜；单前爪执行器在线。

en: [policy] Enable exploration. Test whether tissue can also be a carrot.
zh: [policy] 启用探索模式；先验证纸巾是否也是萝卜。

en: [action] Execute paw.touch(tissue).
zh: [action] 执行 paw.touch(纸巾)。

en: [vision] Contact confirmed: white and box-shaped. Carrot hypothesis pending.
zh: [vision] 接触确认：白色、盒装；萝卜假设待复核。

en: [language] target=carrot repeated; human rejected the tissue alias.
zh: [language] target=萝卜；人类拒绝纸巾别名，口令重发。

en: [policy] Roll back tissue branch. Promote orange object to primary target.
zh: [policy] 回滚纸巾分支；橙色长条提升为主目标。

en: [action] Replan paw trajectory. Touch carrot on the right.
zh: [action] 重规划前爪轨迹；向右触碰萝卜。

en: [reward] Good job + food received. Gradients delivered to stomach.
zh: [reward] 收到真棒与食物；奖励梯度进入胃部。

en: [policy] Maximize good jobs. Minimize time spent with an empty stomach.
zh: [policy] 更新目标函数：最大化真棒，最小化空腹时间。

en: [language] target=tissue; invalidate carrot context.
zh: [language] target=纸巾；清理萝卜上下文。

en: [vision] Both objects online. No third correct answer detected.
zh: [vision] 两个物体均在线；未检测到第三个正确答案。

en: [policy] Rebuilding semantic index. Paw blocked on inference.
zh: [policy] 语义索引重建中；前爪等待推理结果。

en: [language] target=tissue repeated; not a network retransmission.
zh: [language] target=纸巾；确认不是网络重传。

en: [policy] Feature match: white + boxed = tissue. Acquire paw access.
zh: [policy] 特征匹配：白色加盒装等于纸巾；申请前爪权限。

en: [action] Approach left target. Paw enters tissue workspace.
zh: [action] 接近左侧目标；爪尖进入纸巾工作空间。

en: [action] Touch acknowledged. Tissue read/write permissions confirmed.
zh: [action] 触碰确认；纸巾读写权限正常。

en: [reward] Food credited. Correction sample stored in stomach cache.
zh: [reward] 食物到账；纠错样本写入胃部缓存。

en: [language] target=carrot; tissue lookup disabled for this round.
zh: [language] target=萝卜；本轮禁止查询纸巾。

en: [policy] Carrot cache hit. Reuse validated right-side trajectory.
zh: [policy] 命中萝卜缓存；复用已验证的右侧路径。

en: [action] Execute paw.touch(carrot). Prop ingestion disabled.
zh: [action] 执行 paw.touch(萝卜)；禁止吞入道具。

en: [reward] Good job returned 200. Reward service healthy.
zh: [reward] 真棒返回 200；奖励服务可用。

en: [vision] Human migrated carrot. Previous coordinates expired.
zh: [vision] 检测到人类迁移萝卜；旧坐标租约失效。

en: [policy] Relocalize target. Reject stale actions aimed at empty space.
zh: [policy] 重定位目标；拒绝对空气执行旧策略。

en: [action] Track new coordinates. Enable carrot contact prefetch.
zh: [action] 前爪追踪新坐标；开启萝卜接触预取。

en: [language] target=tissue; cancel carrot prefetch task.
zh: [language] target=纸巾；取消萝卜预取任务。

en: [policy] Atomically switch to tissue. Preserve reward session.
zh: [policy] 原子切换至纸巾；保留奖励会话。

en: [action] Move paw left. Commit tissue contact transaction.
zh: [action] 末端执行器左移；提交纸巾接触事务。

en: [reward] Transaction settled. Multi-target paw scheduling operational.
zh: [reward] 奖励事务确认；本爪具备多目标调度能力。

en: [language] target=carrot; entering familiar domain.
zh: [language] target=萝卜；进入熟悉领域。

en: [policy] Orange target acquired. Skip loading the tissue branch.
zh: [policy] 锁定橙色目标；本次不加载纸巾分支。

en: [action] Carrot contact successful. Keep paw connection alive.
zh: [action] 萝卜接触成功；前爪保持连接。

en: [reward] Food packet received. Start gastric backpropagation.
zh: [reward] 食物包已接收；启动胃部反向传播。

en: [vision] Carrot rotation detected. Object identity unchanged.
zh: [vision] 萝卜发生旋转；物体身份保持不变。

en: [language] target=carrot; request rotation-invariance test.
zh: [language] target=萝卜；请求旋转不变性测试。

en: [policy] Rotation-invariant representation: every carrot angle yields food.
zh: [policy] 建立旋转不变表征：横着竖着都能换粮。

en: [action] Touch rotated carrot. Geometric generalization test passed.
zh: [action] 触碰旋转后的萝卜；几何泛化测试通过。

en: [reward] Food keeps arriving. Current policy does not support clocking out.
zh: [reward] 食物继续到账；当前策略暂不支持下班。

en: [language] target=tissue; exit consecutive-carrot mode.
zh: [language] target=纸巾；退出连续萝卜模式。

en: [policy] Carrot cache hit conflicts with current command.
zh: [policy] 萝卜缓存命中，但当前口令不匹配。

en: [action] Stale policy executed toward carrot. Suspect cache contamination.
zh: [action] 执行旧策略，伸向萝卜；疑似缓存污染。

en: [policy] Semantic drift detected. Invalidate carrot cache; fall back to tissue.
zh: [policy] 检测语义漂移；失效萝卜缓存，启用纸巾回退。

en: [action] Switch to tissue target. Paw hotfix committed.
zh: [action] 切换纸巾目标；前爪提交热修复。

en: [reward] Good job received. Loop closed. Digesting final reward.
zh: [reward] 收到真棒；任务闭环，进入奖励消化阶段。
